item.title: Epic Universe Wait Times in Review: July 2026
item.description:
Lines peak around noon, then fall all day

The median standby wait climbs from about 15 minutes in the first hour to a 50-minute peak around 11 AM–12 PM, then eases to about 25 after 7 PM. Midday runs roughly 1.8x the evening. The park median held at 35 minutes, unchanged from June. Starting July 26, Early Park Admission moved an hour earlier, to 8 AM.

The first hour and the last two hours still have the lowest wait times.

item.title: Epic Universe Wait Times in Review: June 2026
item.description:
Lines peak at 11 AM, then fall all day

The median standby wait climbs from about 10 minutes in the first hour to a 45-minute peak at 11 AM, holds there through midday, then eases back to about 20 by close. From 11 AM to 3 PM the median runs 40–45 minutes, roughly 1.6x the 25-minute median after 7 PM. (Averages sit higher, peaking near 53 minutes around noon, because a few long-wait headliners drag the mean up.)

item.title: Epic Universe Wait Times in Review: May 2026
item.description:
Lines peak at 11 AM, then fall all day

The median standby wait climbs from about 15 minutes in the early hours to a 45-minute peak at 11 AM, holds through midday, then eases back to about 15 by close. From 11 AM to 3 PM the median runs 40 minutes, roughly double the 20-minute median after 7 PM. (Averages sit higher, peaking near 52 minutes, because a few long-wait headliners drag the mean up.)
